item.tib: gnas mchog g.yung drung bkod pa'i bsang mchod
item.coloph: ces pa'i 'du gnas g.yung drung bkod pa'i gnas bdag bsang mchod 'di ni/ mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang / dngos slob ye shes bstan 'dzin/ g.yung drung tshul khrims/ bstan 'dzin ye shes/ bsod nams dbang grags/ a drung sogs kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas mar me'i 'od snang la bris so//
